title: AIG Key Executives Bonus Accountability and Capture (TAKE BACK) Act
short_title: AIG Key Executives Bonus Accountability and Capture (TAKE BACK) Act

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR E701-702)
Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

latest_action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

summaries.text: AIG Key Executives Bonus Accountability and Capture (TAKE BACK) Act - Amends the Internal Revenue Code to impose a 100% income tax on bonuses (over $1) paid to employees by entities who received financial assistance under the Troubled Asset Relief Program (TARP).
